![Sub2API – Open AI API Gateway for Subscription Quota Distribution & Multi-Account Management official screenshot](https://www.ai-all.info/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages-st.zkenny.com%2Farticles%2Fai-models%2Fcovers%2Fcae7a1173713b5a98fc3ca646bad7e92.webp&w=2048&q=75)

Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway platform for distributing and managing API quotas from AI product subscriptions, developed primarily by Wesley Liddick.

## 1. What Is Sub2API
Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway platform for distributing and managing API quotas from AI product subscriptions, developed primarily by Wesley Liddick.

In the AI gateway space it positions around "subscription quota distribution" rather than generic multi-model proxying.

**Core value:** Through multi-account management, intelligent scheduling, and token-level billing, Sub2API helps users reduce AI subscription costs within the rights their accounts already grant, while providing a unified API entry point, built-in payment, and a web admin console — packaging "multi-account ops + billing + distribution + monitoring" into a one-stop private gateway.

## 6. Editor's Take
Sub2API's "subscription quota distribution" positioning sets it apart in the AI gateway space.

Overall, Sub2API is a highly innovative tool in both engineering and product positioning, and its 30.9k stars and Trendshift listing confirm strong market demand for private AI gateways.

# Sub2API：订阅转API网关平台，魔芋AI接入指南
### 一、Sub2API 是什么？
Sub2API是一款完全开源的 [AI](https://link.csdn.net/?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgitcode.com%2FCherryHQ%2Fcherry-studio%3Futm_source%3Ddevpress_gitcode_keyword) 订阅API网关中转分发管理平台，核心作用就是把市面上各类AI订阅服务统一转换为标准API接口，同时自带多账号管理、配额分发、精确计费全套能力。

**一句话**：把你的 AI 订阅账号（Claude Pro、ChatGPT Plus、Gemini 等）变成标准 API 接口，统一管理、智能调度、按量计费。
